title: Supported data interface for @kanbus/ui embedders (issues and KanbanConfig without a fourth parser)
description: Requested 2026-10-19 by the Chatticus session, which still carries its own issue-JSON parser and default board config in web/lib/kanbus-board.ts and wants to delete it. Today there is no published JS library that turns a project directory into IssueCollection issues or .kanbus.yml into KanbanConfig. The only JS loader is apps/console/server/index.ts (dev server, unpublished, already flagged by the engineering review kbs-29c41525 as a duplicate). The canonical implementations are Rust and Python. Decide one supported interface and document it in packages/ui/README.md: (a) the console HTTP API (kbsc /api/issues and /api/config, already IssueCollection/KanbanConfig shaped) with a typed client exported from @kanbus/ui, and/or (b) kbs CLI JSON output, and/or (c) a published JS package; adding (c) creates a fourth parser and must justify itself against the parity policy. Spec the chosen contract (payload shape matches the exported KanbusIssue/KanbanConfig types) so Chatticus, Papyrus and the console share it. Related: kbs-3307b32a (embedder support).
